title: •Kalit
caption: •Kalit (V)
game_text: Deploys only on Tatooine. Your other Jawas are power and forfeit +1. Your vehicle forfeited at same site satisfies all remaining battle damage against you. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with “Jawa” in game text.
lore: Jawa *leader*. Seeking to peacefully settle a long-standing disagreement with his rival, Wittin. Wants Jabba to mediate their talks.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 5. Icon column empty. Alien (Jabba's Palace frame, alien disc). ▲ where the stub expands the phrase; curly double quotes around “Jawa” (stub straight). Lore corrected from the scan: 'long-standing' hyphenated (broken 'long-/standing' at the line end; wiki 'long standing'). 'leader' looks the same weight as the surrounding words on the 350 px scan, so it is left plain (not marked bold) — low-res only, worth a check if a better scan turns up. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace) not legible on it. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px). Bold *leader* inferred from the Jabba's Palace printing pattern (Wooof, Jabba, Fozec show bold characteristics on 745 px scans); only 350 px scans of this card exist.
